sections.appearance: Tsukuyo has waist-length dark purple hair with a yellow interior with bangs that cover her right eye and frame her face, with the addition of her purple eyes. She also has lowered bunny ears. Halo ==== Tsukuyo has a light pink halo resembling an upside down sakura, with its center formed by 5 small ovals and each petal having a diamond within, alongside 5 curved diamonds in between the petals. Uniform ==== Tsukuyo wears a short white dress shirt that reveals her waist, paired with a light purple cardigan. She also sports a magenta scarf with flower patterns, long enough to reach her thighs. Additionally, she wears a black pleated skirt that falls below the calf and has an opening on the left side, exposing her entire leg. Her left thigh is wrapped in bandages, and she has a black cloth around her hip. In her Gym version, she wore a gym T-shirt with a pink collar and cuffs, matching the color of her gym pants with two stripes on the sides. She was wearing white shoes with pink soles Firearm ==== She uses a white Orita M1941 with lavender receiver furniture and muzzle, and black stock. Gold floral pattern decals pepper the handguard and stock.

sections.personality: Since Tsukuyo grew tall at an early age and is often made fun of, she became reclusive, timid, and too shy to talk to others, but she also has the strength to jump into any situation once she sets her mind to it. Although she is not very familiar with Ninjutsu yet, she seems to be enjoying her time in the Ninjutsu Research Club with Michiru and Izuna.
